description:
The in-frame InDel predictive (CDS_PRD) step (SM 10).

The SSR branch scores 0.0 (stable in controls) or −1.0 (polymorphic); the
non-repeat branch derives initial points from the protein fraction removed / a
critical domain / an indel in-silico predictor, then applies the SM 18 matrix.

adjusted_points.description: Coded CDS_PRD points after the SM 18 adjustment.
adjusted_points.title: Adjusted Points

basis.description: Predictive basis (e.g. repeat length; deleted fraction).
basis.title: Basis

in_silico_calibrated.description: Whether the indel predictor is calibrated (calibrated reaches +2.0).
in_silico_calibrated.title: In Silico Calibrated

in_silico_predictor.description: Indel in-silico predictor used (e.g. MutationTaster2021, PROVEAN).
in_silico_predictor.title: In Silico Predictor

initial_points.description: Initial CDS_PRD points before the SM 18 adjustment.
initial_points.title: Initial Points

protein_fraction_reduced.description: Fraction of protein removed (the non-repeat initial-points table).
protein_fraction_reduced.title: Protein Fraction Reduced

repeat_stable_in_controls.description: SSR branch: the repeat is stable in large control sets (else polymorphic).
repeat_stable_in_controls.title: Repeat Stable In Controls

title: InframeIndelPredictiveEvidence
